questions.question:
By interchanging the given two signs which of the following equations will be correct?

× and +
questions.solution:
By interchanging the given two signs × and + then,

1) 6 × 11 + 13 ÷ 11 = 17

6 + 11 × 13 ÷ 11 = 17

6 + 13 = 17

19 = 17 (False)

2) 4 + 9 × 11 ÷ 3 = 37

4 × 9 + 11 ÷ 3 = 37

4 × 9 + 3.67 = 37

36 + 3.67 = 37

39.67 = 37 (False)

3) 11 × 6 ÷ 18 + 54 = 29

11 + 6 ÷ 18 × 54 = 29

11 + 18 = 29

29 = 29 (True)

So, option 3 is true therefore no need to check the other options.

Thus, the correct answer is “11 × 6 ÷ 18 + 54 = 29”.

questions.question:
After interchanging the given signs, what will be the value of 16 + 19 × 51 ÷ 153 – 12?

× and ÷
questions.solution:
Given equation:- 16 + 19 × 51 ÷ 153 – 12

After interchanging the signs × and ÷ then,

16 + 19 ÷ 51 × 153 – 12

16 + 57 – 12

73 – 12

61.

Thus, the correct answer is ‘61’.
